newsitem.title: UK: Utd News says early 97 trading in line.
newsitem.headline: Utd News says early 97 trading in line.

text.p: British television and newspaper group United News & Media Plc said its trading at the start of 1997 had been "well in line with expectations".
The company, which effectively doubled in size when it merged with MAI last year, said profit before tax and exceptional items rose 12 percent in 1996 to 290.2 million pounds ($466 million).
United said savings as a result of the merger and subsequent restructuring, are expected to reach 43 million pounds a year by 1998, excluding development expenditure.
"The first year following the United/MAI merger has been an excellent one," said chief executive Clive Hollick.
"There has been good growth in both profits and earnings per share. The review of the businesses following the merger has been completed," he added.
A final dividend of 15.5 pence per share is being paid, bringing the total for the year to 23.5p, an increase of two percent on the 1995 figure. ($1=.6228 Pound)
